            visited.add(current_node)

            current_paths = [new_path for new_path in current_paths if new_path[-1] == goal]
    return current_paths[0] if current_paths else None

        return [start]
    visited = set()
    stack = [[start]]
    while stack:
        path = stack.pop()
        node = path[-1]
        if node not in visited:
            visited.add(node)
            neighbors = graph.get(node, [])
            for neighbor in neighbors:
                new_path = path + [neighbor]
                if neighbor == goal:
                    return new_path
                else:
                    stack.append(new_path)
    return None
